adjudication.rationale: Looking at parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts lines 24-26, when refresh_token is missing from the response, the code sets it to the literal string 'refresh_token'. This fabricated value then gets stored in the database. In Office365CalendarService.ts line 256, the code does `o365AuthCredentials = { ...o365AuthCredentials, ...(tokenResponse.success && tokenResponse.data) }` which would overwrite the existing valid refresh_token with this fake 'refresh_token' string if the response doesn't include a new refresh_token. This would break subsequent token refreshes since the stored refresh_token would be invalid.
